properties.name: spring.web.view.engine
properties.description: Template engines (comma-separated): thymeleaf, freemarker, beetl. Empty -> register all available on classpath.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.prefix
properties.description: Thymeleaf template prefix (classpath-relative path).

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.suffix
properties.description: Thymeleaf template suffix.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.cache
properties.description: Enable Thymeleaf template cache and the view-name-to-View resolution cache. Set false for hot reload.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Thymeleaf view resolver is enabled. A disabled resolver is excluded from startup validation.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.order
properties.description: View resolver order (lower wins). Defaults place thymeleaf before freemarker, beetl and jsp.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.encoding
properties.description: Character encoding used to read Thymeleaf template files. The response charset comes from the Content-Type.

properties.name: spring.freemarker.prefix
properties.description: FreeMarker template prefix (classpath-relative path).

properties.name: spring.freemarker.suffix
properties.description: FreeMarker template suffix.

properties.name: spring.freemarker.cache
properties.description: Enable FreeMarker template cache and the view-name-to-View resolution cache. Set false for hot reload.

properties.name: spring.freemarker.enabled
properties.description: Whether the FreeMarker view resolver is enabled. A disabled resolver is excluded from startup validation.

properties.name: spring.freemarker.order
properties.description: View resolver order (lower wins). Defaults place thymeleaf before freemarker, beetl and jsp.

properties.name: spring.beetl.prefix
properties.description: Beetl template prefix (classpath-relative path).

properties.name: spring.beetl.suffix
properties.description: Beetl template suffix.

properties.name: spring.beetl.cache
properties.description: Enable Beetl template cache and the view-name-to-View resolution cache. Set false for hot reload.

properties.name: spring.beetl.cache-ttl
properties.description: Beetl template cache TTL (Duration style, e.g. 60s); takes effect only if the configured cache implementation supports TTL.

properties.name: spring.beetl.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Beetl view resolver is enabled. A disabled resolver is excluded from startup validation.

properties.name: spring.beetl.order
properties.description: View resolver order (lower wins). Defaults place thymeleaf before freemarker, beetl and jsp.

properties.name: spring.web.view.jsp.order
properties.description: JSP view resolver order (lower wins). Defaults after thymeleaf, freemarker and beetl.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.mode
properties.description: Thymeleaf TemplateMode: HTML, XML, TEXT, JAVASCRIPT, CSS or RAW. Invalid values fail startup.

properties.name: spring.thymeleaf.cache-ttl
properties.description: Template cache TTL (Duration style, e.g. 10m); <=0 means never expires.

properties.name: spring.freemarker.template-loader-path
properties.description: FreeMarker template loader path (classpath-relative); overrides spring.freemarker.prefix when set.

properties.name: spring.freemarker.settings
properties.description: FreeMarker native settings as comma-separated key=value pairs.

properties.name: spring.freemarker.content-type
properties.description: Response Content-Type; its charset determines the response byte encoding. Invalid values fail startup.
